situation (example wording): "Shoplifting in Houston and Dallas combined by year", "Which Texas cities had the biggest increase in robberies" (multi-agency trends, when built)
proposed behavior: When built, one shared every-month test (a month with crimes reported, VALUE, in every month of the span, with a header every year; a zero report is not a reported month, P121), but each kind keeps its own row: state and national sums P61 (everything reported, with the Consistent Reporting Agencies button); several named agencies combined P58 (a figure only when every month is known for every agency, the missing months named); rankings P60 (complete reporters only, those left out named, no button to include them).
exact default or choices offered: Each kind's own row; one shared test.
why: Reusing P61's default for rankings or named agencies would let reporting gaps decide a ranking or give a rate P58 forbids (Codex design check 01).
